name: Mugen no Sakura 2
source:
The Infinite Sky. The Infinite Earth. A continent that embraced all the world.  
At its heart lay the Elven Kingdom of Maradian—a land of abundance and blessings,  
a realm filled with dreams, compassion, love, and joy.  

Using the "Interdimensional Transfer Device (Gate),"  
a heretic from another world led an army of cursed dead to invade the human realm.  
The fierce battle that followed ultimately ended in a hard-won victory for humanity.  
The mastermind behind the invasion was vanquished  
thanks to the efforts of the Crimson Princess Artesia (Asha) and Harukaze Sakura.  

Having successfully quelled the rebellion in the Elven Kingdom of Maradian,  
Harukaze Sakura returned to a peaceful life alongside Asha and her friend, Shibaame Yuzuha.  
The remaining Gate was classified as a top-secret matter,  
placed under the strict surveillance and protection of the Guild—or so it was believed.  

However—  

Peace did not last long.  
An assault came from Kingdick, the Kingdom of Giants (Gigants),  
a nation thought to have been destroyed.  
An unprecedented crisis loomed over the human world once more. 

Four [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/sakura2/about_omake.html]omake scenarios[/url] were made available at a later date:
2022-08-05: Buffolion
2022-08-12: Kyouka
2022-08-19: Yuzuha
2022-08-26: Jasper
translation:
无边无际的天空。无限的地球。一片拥抱世界的大陆。
它的中心是马拉迪安精灵王国——一片富饶和祝福的土地，
一个充满梦想、慈悲、爱和欢乐的境界。

使用“异次元传送装置（门）”  
来自另一个世界的异教徒率领一支被诅咒的亡灵大军入侵人类领域。
随后的激烈战斗最终以人类来之不易的胜利告终。
入侵的幕后主使被击败  
感谢红之公主阿尔黛西亚（亚莎）和小樱春风的努力。

成功平息了马拉迪安精灵王国的叛乱，
佐仓春风与阿莎和她的朋友柴雨柚叶一起回归平静的生活。
剩下的门被列为绝密事项，
受到公会的严格监视和保护——至少人们是这么认为的。

然而——  

和平并没有持续多久。
来自巨人王国（巨人国）金迪克的攻击，
一个被认为已被毁灭的国家。
人类世界再次面临前所未有的危机。

稍后提供了四个 [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/sakura2/about_omake.html]omake场景[/url]：
